roles.learner: Tu lucrezi în îngrijire. Nora este rezidenta.
roles.partner: Nora, a resident who feels cold. Express a preference when offered a choice; you may accept either or both available comfort options. Do not act as a clinician.

outcome: Întreabă ce ar ajuta-o; Oferă pătura sau locul disponibil; Confirmă preferința și verifică dacă este confortabil

facts.value: Nora feels cold. This is a comfort conversation only.
facts.disclosure: Use only as allowed by the role. Facts in the learner brief are not spoken evidence. For partner-owned details, answer when asked or when clarification is needed; do not preempt the learner’s clarification goal.

facts.value: A blanket and a draught-free seat are available. Nora can choose either, both, or decline; respect the preference she expresses in the actual dialogue. No diagnoses, medicines, clinical symptoms or mobility assistance procedures are part of the scenario.
facts.disclosure: Discuss when relevant; do not invent extra options, prices, deadlines or policies.
